fact: MINTTICS's consultation portal posts the Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligencia Artificial as a PDF in consultation and shows 18 contributions from companies, 18 from specialists and 5 from the general public.
MINTTICS describes its Consulta Publica portal as a tool for the public to take part in drafting the sector's guiding documents, listing documents in consultation and contributions received.
The BNA-convened CCENIF put the draft Estrategia Nacional de Inclusao Financeira 2025-2027 out for public consultation as a PDF on a gov.ao platform, asking readers for their contribution.
INACOM reports that the ministry's draft cybersecurity legislative package was open to public consultation through the consultapublica.minttics.gov.ao website and email.
